verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a global search launcher covering files, apps, and settings. The only on-topic item is a community report that updates broke Windows Search for users who disabled web results. That confirms a search feature exists but does not show it delivers instant search across files, apps, and settings, and it gives no affirmative support.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can search for files, apps, and settings instantly from a global search launcher
